scenes.speaker: haeun
scenes.text: Hey! Welcome to Seoul. I'm Haeun — I'll be showing you around tonight.

scenes.speaker: haeun
scenes.text: See all these signs? They're written in Hangul — the Korean alphabet. Let me teach you the basics.

scenes.speaker: haeun
scenes.text: Let's start with ㅎ — this is 'hieut', the 'h' sound. Try tracing it!

scenes.speaker: haeun
scenes.text: Nice! That's the 'h' in my name — Haeun. Now let's learn the vowel ㅏ — that's 'ah'.

scenes.speaker: haeun
scenes.text: You're getting it! Now put them together — ㅎ + ㅏ = 하. That means 'ha' — like the start of my name!

scenes.speaker: haeun
scenes.text: Perfect! Let's practice ㅎ a few more times to build muscle memory.

scenes.speaker: haeun
scenes.text: Amazing work! You just learned your first Korean characters. Next time, we'll learn more consonants. See you around the food street!
